pages.name: Dashboard
pages.description: Use the Dashboard to review the company’s current trip activity, monthly performance, service totals, revenue, miles, and billing status.

pages.name: Add Trip
pages.description: Create Individual or Shared trips. Shared trips support Manual Shared and Automatic Shared modes, including Return Time and Shared Engine grouping.

pages.name: Review
pages.description: Review company trips before final confirmation, make allowed changes, confirm trips, cancel trips when permitted, and handle route changes such as Add Stop.

pages.name: Summary
pages.description: Search and review company trip history, filter by service, view detailed trip information, and export or print reports.

pages.name: Payment
pages.description: Review account status, the current invoice, next payment date, billing cycle, available payment methods, and payment history.

pages.name: Taxes
pages.description: Review transportation billing and tax summary information, revenue and status totals, detailed trip rows, and export or print the report.
